column3: I make fairy tales out of data
PhD | Data Science | Software Engineering | Writing

PhD in data mining and 17 years of industry experience building software for healthcare, education and emerging tech. I bridge the academia and the industry: influence mining, machine learning, health informatics and decentralised systems.

As an Associate Professor at Karachi Institute of Economics and Technology, my core responsibility is to produce state-of-art research and publish key findings to reputed journals. Alongside this, I teach undergraduate courses of both a theoretical and practical nature, supervising final year projects, project evaluations, and aligning the Software Engineering curriculum with NCEAC requirements. I also volunteer as a teacher at Esquared Academy, where I teach Cambridge students, and as teaching volunteer at GirlsWhoML.
Besides the university courses, I run short trainings for engineering teams, meetups and student groups. Some are a single talk, some run for days. The decks are here as they were delivered.
